# LeiCNS-PK3.2: A physiologically based pharmacokinetic model framework for predicting intracellular concentrations of acyclovir and ganciclovir active metabolites (Sun M, Manson ML, Guo T, de Lange ECM, Eur J Pharm Sci 2026)

Reference: doi:10.1016/j.ejps.2026.107496 (Eur J Pharm Sci 2026;221:107496; Tables 1 and 2, Eq. 3-4 and Supplementary File). CNS framework: LeiCNS-PK3.0, Saleh MAA et al., J Pharmacokinet Pharmacodyn 2021;48:725-741 (healthy human physiological parameters, Supplementary table 2 and Supplementary Fig. 1).

**Model type: illustrative model only, not a population pharmacokinetic model** (CNS physiologically based pharmacokinetic model LeiCNS-PK3.2 with an empirical plasma model estimated in Monolix 2021R2 from mean literature data; no interindividual variability or residual error reported). Kept for illustration of plasma, brain ECF, lumbar CSF and intracellular aciclovir-triphosphate exposure; not intended for MAP Bayesian estimation. Caution: the model code was not published, the paracellular clearances are back-calculated and the triphosphate formation rate is not reported (triphosphate exposure is relative only, see Notes).

## Notes

- Model: extension of LeiCNS-PK3.0 (see `ACV_Sun_2025.Rmd` for the same CNS structure) with (1) an asymmetry factor at the brain cell membrane derived from Kp,uu,cell and (2) intracellular conversion of aciclovir to aciclovir-triphosphate (TP) in brain ICF, dC_TP/dt = kform x C_ICF - kelim x C_TP (Eq. 3). Plasma and lumbar CSF data after oral valaciclovir (Lycke et al. 2003, 1000 mg three times daily; Smith et al. 2010, 2000 mg four times daily) were used for the human plasma model and for validation. This file is the IV aciclovir version used by the authors for the simulations (10 mg/kg three times daily); the oral valaciclovir version is `adulte/valaciclovir_VO/models/VACV_Sun_2026.Rmd`.
- Plasma model (Table 2, human aciclovir): one-compartment, CLCen/F 917 mL/min, VCen/F 176,745 mL, ka 0.025 min-1, Tlag 51 min (printed "min-1"), F 54.5% (fixed, Soul-Lawton et al.). For IV aciclovir, CL = 917 x 0.545 = 500 mL/min (30.0 L/h) and V = 176.7 x 0.545 = 96.3 L. **Ambiguity:** the dose basis of the apparent parameters (mg of valaciclovir or aciclovir equivalents) is not stated. **Choice:** CL/F and V/F per mg of valaciclovir, without molar conversion (same order of magnitude as the plasma clearance of Sun et al. 2025, 34 L/h); with the molar conversion CL and V would be 31% lower.
- CNS physiology: healthy human values of LeiCNS-PK3.0 (Saleh 2021): VECF 253 mL, VICF 1000 mL, VLYS 12.5 mL, VMV 47 mL (Sun 2025 Table S1; Saleh gives 45), VLV 20 mL, VTFV 3 mL, VCM 1 mL, VSAS 116 mL, QCBF 689 mL/min, QECF 0.2 mL/min, QCSF 0.42 mL/min, SABBB 150,000 cm2, SABCSFB 15,000 cm2, BBB and BCSFB width 0.5 um, SABCM 2,666,520 cm2, SALYS 1,980,260 cm2, effective surface areas 99.8% (transcellular), 0.004% and 0.016% (paracellular), pH 7.4/7.3/7.3/7.0/5.0. Drug: MW 225.2, logP -0.95, pKa 11.98, pKb 3.02 (pH factors > 0.99 everywhere).
- Kp,uu (Table 1, human aciclovir): Kp,uu,BBB 0.32 (rat value), Kp,uu,BCSFB 0.26 (Lycke 2003, Smith 2010), Kp,uu,cell 1 (AF at the brain cell membrane = 1, passive exchange). Published efflux asymmetry factors (AF in = 1): AFout,ECF 34.51, AFout,LV 1456.66, AFout,TFV 1469.38; they are used directly.
- **Ambiguity:** the paracellular clearances of the published model include a pore-size restriction that is not published; with unrestricted diffusion the published AF would not give the published Kp,uu. **Choice:** the paracellular clearances of the BBB and BCSFB are back-calculated in the model from the steady-state mass balance so that the published AF give Kp,uu,ECF = 0.32 and Kp,uu,LV = 0.26 (about 5.4 and 18 mL/min, versus 45.6 and 18.3 mL/min for unrestricted diffusion); transcellular clearances Qt = 0.5 x P0 x SA x 0.998 with log10 P0 = 0.939 x logP - 6.21 (cm/s).
- Brain cell membrane and lysosomes: as in `ACV_Sun_2025.Rmd` (CLwo = 0.5 x P0 x SABCM, CLow = CLwo / Poct, QLYSO = 0.5 x P0 x SALYS; assumptions, not published). Plasma unbound fraction 1 (assumed).
- Aciclovir-TP: kelim = ln(2)/27 h (Sauer et al. 2020); kform = (CTP,ss/Cparent,ss) x kelim (Eq. 4), with the in vitro steady-state ratio in HSV-infected cells, which is not reported. **Choice:** ratio set to 1 (`TP_RATIO`); the captured `TP_REL` is the TP concentration divided by this unknown ratio (relative exposure only; the shape and accumulation do not depend on the ratio). With a 27-h half-life, TP keeps increasing over the first six doses, as reported by the authors, whereas brain ECF aciclovir is at steady state after the first interval.
- Variability and residual error: none reported. For mapbayr compatibility only, nominal random effects of 30% (omega^2 0.0862, assumed) on plasma CL and V, and 20% proportional errors (assumed) in plasma (cmt 1) and lumbar CSF (cmt 10), captured as `PAR` and `MET` (mapbayr names; MET is not a metabolite here).
- Simulation check (70 kg, 700 mg every 8 h, 1-h infusion, day 6): plasma Cmax 6.8, Cmin 0.77 mg/L, AUC8 23.3 mg.h/L; brain ECF Cmax 1.8, Cmin 0.35 mg/L, AUC8 7.5 mg.h/L; lumbar CSF Cmax 0.89, Cmin 0.57 mg/L, AUC8 6.1 mg.h/L. The CNS-to-plasma AUC ratios equal the Kp,uu (0.32 and 0.26) and brain ECF troughs fall below the IC50 of HSV and VZV (0.56 and 1.125 mg/L), as reported (Fig. 3). Accumulation ratio (day 6 versus first interval): 1.2 for brain ECF aciclovir and 27 for TP. Back-calculated paracellular clearances: 5.3 mL/min (BBB) and 18.2 mL/min (BCSFB).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(mrgsolve)
library(mapbayr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r model}
code <- '
[PROB]
Sun et al. 2026 - aciclovir CNS PBPK model LeiCNS-PK3.2 (healthy human CNS physiology, empirical plasma model estimated
in Monolix from mean valaciclovir data, intracellular aciclovir-triphosphate module). IV aciclovir.
One-compartment plasma model connected to the CNS model (microvasculature, ECF, cell membrane, ICF with TP formation,
lysosomes, lateral ventricles, 3rd-4th ventricles, cisterna magna, SAS). No IIV or residual error reported
(nominal values for mapbayr only).

[SET] end = 24, delta = 0.1

[PARAM] @annotated
CLF_ML   : 917       : Apparent plasma clearance CL/F (mL/min)
VF_ML    : 176745    : Apparent plasma volume V/F (mL)
FVAL     : 0.545     : Bioavailability used to derive the IV parameters (CL = CL/F x F, V = V/F x F) (ambiguous, see Notes)
VSAS_ML  : 116       : Subarachnoid space volume (mL)
SABBB    : 150000    : BBB surface area (cm2)
QCSF_ML  : 0.42      : CSF flow (mL/min)
VECF_ML  : 253       : Brain ECF volume (mL)
VICF_ML  : 1000      : Brain intracellular fluid volume (mL)
VLYS_ML  : 12.5      : Brain cell lysosome volume (mL)
VMV_ML   : 47        : Brain microvasculature volume (mL)
VLV_ML   : 20        : Lateral ventricle volume (mL)
VTFV_ML  : 3         : Third and fourth ventricle volume (mL)
VCM_ML   : 1         : Cisterna magna volume (mL)
VTOT_ML  : 1250      : Total brain volume (mL)
QCBF_ML  : 689       : Cerebral blood flow (mL/min)
QECF_ML  : 0.2       : Brain ECF bulk flow (mL/min)
SABCSFB  : 15000     : BCSFB surface area (cm2)
SABCM    : 2666520   : Brain cell membrane surface area (cm2)
SALYS    : 1980260   : Lysosome membrane surface area (cm2)
FT_T     : 0.998     : Effective surface area fraction, transcellular (BBB and BCSFB)
LOGP     : -0.95     : Octanol-water partition coefficient (log10)
PKA      : 11.98     : Strongest acidic pKa
PKB      : 3.02      : Strongest basic pKa
PH_PL    : 7.4       : pH plasma and brain microvasculature
PH_ECF   : 7.3       : pH brain ECF
PH_CSF   : 7.3       : pH CSF
PH_ICF   : 7.0       : pH brain cells
PH_LYS   : 5.0       : pH lysosomes
KPUU_ECF : 0.32      : Kp,uu,BBB, brain ECF-to-plasma
KPUU_CSF : 0.26      : Kp,uu,BCSFB, CSF-to-plasma
AFEF_BBB : 34.51     : Efflux asymmetry factor, BBB (Table 1)
AFEF_LV  : 1456.66   : Efflux asymmetry factor, BCSFB lateral ventricles (Table 1)
AFEF_TFV : 1469.38   : Efflux asymmetry factor, BCSFB third and fourth ventricles (Table 1)
TPHALF   : 27        : Aciclovir-TP intracellular half-life (h)
TP_RATIO : 1         : In vitro steady-state TP-to-parent ratio for kform (not reported) (ambiguous, see Notes)
ETA1     : 0         : Nominal random effect CL (not estimated)
ETA2     : 0         : Nominal random effect V (not estimated)

[CMT] @annotated
CENT : Plasma central compartment, aciclovir (mg) [ADM, OBS]
MV   : Brain microvasculature (mg)
ECF  : Brain extracellular fluid (mg)
MEM  : Brain cell membrane, bound (mg)
ICF  : Brain intracellular fluid (mg)
LYS  : Brain cell lysosomes (mg)
LV   : CSF, lateral ventricles (mg)
TFV  : CSF, third and fourth ventricles (mg)
CM   : CSF, cisterna magna (mg)
SAS  : CSF, subarachnoid space, lumbar (mg) [OBS]
TPC  : Aciclovir-triphosphate in brain ICF, relative concentration (mg/L equivalent / TP_RATIO)

[MAIN]
// volumes (L) and flows (L/h); mL/min x 0.06 = L/h, mL/s x 3.6 = L/h
double CLE  = CLF_ML * FVAL * 0.06 * exp(ETA1 + ETA(1));
double VCEN = VF_ML * FVAL / 1000 * exp(ETA2 + ETA(2));
double VSAS = VSAS_ML / 1000;
double VECF = VECF_ML / 1000;
double VICF = VICF_ML / 1000;
double VLYS = VLYS_ML / 1000;
double VMV = VMV_ML / 1000;
double VLV = VLV_ML / 1000;
double VTFV = VTFV_ML / 1000;
double VCM = VCM_ML / 1000;
double VMEM = 0.05 * VTOT_ML / 1000;
double QCBF = QCBF_ML * 0.06;
double QECF = QECF_ML * 0.06;
double QCSF = QCSF_ML * 0.06;
// pH factors (neutral fractions)
double PHF_MV  = 1 / (1 + pow(10, PH_PL  - PKA)) / (1 + pow(10, PKB - PH_PL));
double PHF_ECF = 1 / (1 + pow(10, PH_ECF - PKA)) / (1 + pow(10, PKB - PH_ECF));
double PHF_CSF = 1 / (1 + pow(10, PH_CSF - PKA)) / (1 + pow(10, PKB - PH_CSF));
double PHF_ICF = 1 / (1 + pow(10, PH_ICF - PKA)) / (1 + pow(10, PKB - PH_ICF));
double PHF_LYS = 1 / (1 + pow(10, PH_LYS - PKA)) / (1 + pow(10, PKB - PH_LYS));
// transcellular clearances (L/h)
double P0  = pow(10, 0.939 * LOGP - 6.21);
double QT_BBB   = 0.5 * P0 * SABBB * FT_T * 3.6;
double QT_BCSFB = 0.5 * P0 * SABCSFB * FT_T * 3.6;
double CLWO  = 0.5 * P0 * SABCM * 3.6;
double CLOW  = CLWO / pow(10, LOGP);
double QLYSO = 0.5 * P0 * SALYS * 3.6;
// paracellular clearances back-calculated so that the published AF give the published Kp,uu at steady state
double KE = KPUU_ECF;
double KL = KPUU_CSF;
double CMV_SS = 1 - QCSF * KPUU_CSF / QCBF;
double QP_BBB   = (QECF * KE + QT_BBB * AFEF_BBB * PHF_ECF * KE - QT_BBB * PHF_MV * CMV_SS) / (CMV_SS - KE);
double QP_BCSFB = (QCSF * KL - QECF * KE + QT_BCSFB * AFEF_LV * PHF_CSF * KL - QT_BCSFB * PHF_MV * CMV_SS) / (CMV_SS - KL);
// aciclovir-triphosphate kinetics
double KELIM = log(2) / TPHALF;
double KFORM = TP_RATIO * KELIM;

[ODE]
double CPL = CENT / VCEN;
double CMV = MV / VMV;
double CECF = ECF / VECF;
double CMEM = MEM / VMEM;
double CICF = ICF / VICF;
double CLYS = LYS / VLYS;
double CLV = LV / VLV;
double CTFV = TFV / VTFV;
double CCM = CM / VCM;
double CSASc = SAS / VSAS;
double J_BBB = (QP_BBB + QT_BBB * PHF_MV) * CMV - (QP_BBB + QT_BBB * AFEF_BBB * PHF_ECF) * CECF;
double J_LV  = (QP_BCSFB + QT_BCSFB * PHF_MV) * CMV - (QP_BCSFB + QT_BCSFB * AFEF_LV * PHF_CSF) * CLV;
double J_TFV = (QP_BCSFB + QT_BCSFB * PHF_MV) * CMV - (QP_BCSFB + QT_BCSFB * AFEF_TFV * PHF_CSF) * CTFV;
double J_EM  = CLWO * PHF_ECF * CECF - CLOW * CMEM;
double J_MI  = CLOW * CMEM - CLWO * PHF_ICF * CICF;
double J_IL  = QLYSO * (PHF_ICF * CICF - PHF_LYS * CLYS);
dxdt_CENT = -CLE * CPL - QCBF * (CPL - CMV) + QCSF * CSASc;
dxdt_MV   =  QCBF * (CPL - CMV) - J_BBB - J_LV - J_TFV;
dxdt_ECF  =  J_BBB - J_EM - QECF * CECF;
dxdt_MEM  =  J_EM - J_MI;
dxdt_ICF  =  J_MI - J_IL;
dxdt_LYS  =  J_IL;
dxdt_LV   =  J_LV + QECF * CECF - QCSF * CLV;
dxdt_TFV  =  J_TFV + QCSF * CLV - QCSF * CTFV;
dxdt_CM   =  QCSF * CTFV - QCSF * CCM;
dxdt_SAS  =  QCSF * CCM - QCSF * CSASc;
dxdt_TPC  =  KFORM * CICF - KELIM * TPC;

[OMEGA] @annotated
ECL : 0.0862 : Nominal random effect CL (variance, CV 30%, assumed, not published)
EV  : 0.0862 : Nominal random effect V (variance, CV 30%, assumed, not published)

[SIGMA] @annotated
PROP_PL  : 0.04 : Proportional error, plasma (variance, CV 20%, assumed)
ADD_PL   : 0    : Additive error, plasma, not used
PROP_SAS : 0.04 : Proportional error, lumbar CSF (variance, CV 20%, assumed)
ADD_SAS  : 0    : Additive error, lumbar CSF, not used

[TABLE]
double PAR = CENT / VCEN;
double MET = SAS / VSAS;
double C_ECF = ECF / VECF;
double TP_REL = TPC;
double DV = PAR * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2);
if (self.cmt == 10) DV = MET * (1 + EPS(3)) + EPS(4);

[CAPTURE] @annotated
DV     : Aciclovir concentration, plasma or lumbar CSF according to cmt (mg/L)
PAR    : Aciclovir plasma concentration (mg/L), first observation type (mapbayr name)
MET    : Aciclovir lumbar CSF concentration (mg/L), second observation type (mapbayr name)
C_ECF  : Aciclovir concentration in brain extracellular fluid (mg/L)
TP_REL : Aciclovir-triphosphate in brain ICF, relative (TP concentration / TP_RATIO)
QP_BBB : Back-calculated BBB paracellular clearance (L/h)
QP_BCSFB : Back-calculated BCSFB paracellular clearance (L/h)
'
mod <- mcode("ACV_Sun_2026", code)
```

```{r simulation}
# Standard regimen 10 mg/kg every 8 h (70 kg, 1-h infusion), six days
out <- mod %>%
  zero_re() %>%
  ev(amt = 700, rate = 700, ii = 8, addl = 17) %>%
  mrgsim(end = 144, delta = 0.02) %>%
  as.data.frame()

ss <- out %>% filter(time >= 136) %>% mutate(time = time - 136)
long <- ss %>% select(time, Plasma = PAR, Brain_ECF = C_ECF, Lumbar_CSF = MET) %>%
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "Site", values_to = "Conc")
# Article (Fig. 3): brain ECF troughs below the IC50 (0.56 / 1.125 mg/L), TP accumulating over six doses
long %>% group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Cmax = max(Conc), Cmin = min(Conc), AUC8 = sum(diff(time) * (head(Conc, -1) + tail(Conc, -1)) / 2))
c(QP_BBB_mL_min = out$QP_BBB[1] / 0.06, QP_BCSFB_mL_min = out$QP_BCSFB[1] / 0.06)

# Accumulation ratio AUC(ss)/AUC(first interval) for brain ECF aciclovir and intracellular TP (relative)
auc <- function(d, v) sum(diff(d$time) * (head(d[[v]], -1) + tail(d[[v]], -1)) / 2)
first <- out %>% filter(time <= 8)
c(Rac_ECF = auc(ss, "C_ECF") / auc(first, "C_ECF"), Rac_TP = auc(ss, "TP_REL") / auc(first, "TP_REL"))

ggplot(out, aes(time, TP_REL / mean(ss$TP_REL))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_line(aes(y = C_ECF / mean(ss$C_ECF)), colour = "grey50") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Concentration / average steady-state concentration",
       title = "Sun et al. 2026 - brain ECF aciclovir (grey) and intracellular TP (black), 10 mg/kg q8h")
```
